limitations: Only explicit, durable behavioral evidence through turn 7 is included; ordinary screen requests and one-off tone guidance are excluded.

exclusions: dense internal operator panels covered by the compact-icon exception

claims.statement: Important destructive actions in Willow interfaces must use visible text labels and must not rely on icon-only controls, except under the narrowly scoped dense internal operator-panel exception.

activation_conditions: The action has an accessible name, an adjacent legend, and a tooltip.
The interface is a dense internal operator panel.

claims.statement: On dense internal Willow operator panels only, compact icon actions are acceptable when they have an accessible name, tooltip, and adjacent legend; this exception does not extend to customer-facing destructive actions.
